description: Antigravity CLI (agy) 1.5.9 sanitized session row set. Schema and wire shapes were captured from a real 1.5.9 install on the authorized Debian 13 remote (2026-11-16, docs/verification/remote-workflow/agy-1.5.9/): session data moved from the legacy ~/.gemini/antigravity/ root to ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/ (conversation_summaries.db + conversations/<uuid>.db + brain/<uuid>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl + implicit/<uuid>.pb + annotations/<uuid>.pbtxt); on that machine the legacy root is empty with a ~/.gemini/config/.migrated marker. Differences from the 1.3 fixture: the index column is conversation_id (not id), the workspace column became workspace_uris (JSON array), status values are CASCADE_RUN_STATUS_* enum names, timestamps are 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.fffffffff+00:00' strings, and new columns exist (preview, step_count, source, project_id, agent_name, nesting_depth, battle_id, winning_conversation_id, not_fully_idle, killed, last_user_input_time, last_user_input_step_index, app_data_dir, raw_summary, group_id) plus a conversation_parents(conversation_id, parent_id) table and FTS5 search tables. Per-conversation databases gain executor_metadata/trajectory_meta/trajectory_metadata_blob/parent_references/battle_mode_infos tables; steps rows are (idx, step_type, status, has_subtrajectory, metadata, error_details, permissions, task_details, render_info, step_payload, step_format) and gen_metadata rows keep the protobuf blob layout with observed top-level fields 1 (ChatModel, ~0.8KB), 2, 4 (36-byte uuid string) and a new field 8 (~0.3KB, unknown semantics — parsers must skip it); every sampled real row encodes all four fields length-delimited (wire type 2), so field 2's observed 1.5.9 encoding is length-delimited (repeated/packed), not the bare varint the 1.3 parser documented. transcript_full.jsonl rows are {content, created_at, source, status, step_index, type} with type in USER_INPUT | PLANNER_RESPONSE | GENERIC | SYSTEM_MESSAGE | ERROR_MESSAGE | CHECKPOINT, source in USER_EXPLICIT | MODEL | SYSTEM, status in DONE | RUNNING | ERROR, and PLANNER_RESPONSE rows additionally carry input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, model (slug like gemini-4-carbon-medium), thinking (string) and tool_calls — a second, transcript-side usage source next to the gen_metadata protobuf. Tests rebuild the stores deterministically from these rows; ids/titles/paths/token counts here are replaced neutral values.
